content.text: {"core": "Fulfillment rests in what already satisfies and lets the wanting settle. In Imagination, it works on the inner picture of enough — the felt sense of a life that fills its own cup. Kept quiet, that fullness runs unnamed: the satisfaction feeds the daydream instead of the day, and the picture of having replaces the having.", "sheetLine": "The cup fills in the mind, and the picture of enough stands in for it."}
